create_jointcnn_representation: create a JointCNNRepresentation with doc and word CNN sub-representations for joint document-level and word-level feature extraction
create_sharedcnn_representation: create a SharedCNNRepresentation that shares a single word-level CNN with configurable pooling for document-level features
run_jointcnn_forward: run the JointCNNRepresentation forward pass on embedded tokens to get doc and word representations
run_sharedcnn_forward: run the SharedCNNRepresentation forward pass on embedded tokens to get pooled doc and raw word representations
review_jointcnn_config: review the JointCNNRepresentation Config class to understand doc and word representation configuration options
